title: Bellman-Consistent Trajectory RL for LLM Arithmetic Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.21060v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: To address sparse terminal rewards in LLM arithmetic reasoning, we propose a Bellman-consistent trajectory RL method. Our framework introduces Trajectory Bellman Residual Minimization (TBRM) to transform sparse rewards into dense token-level signals. We integrate a Reinforce Leave-One-Out (RLOO) group strategy to reduce gradient variance of Bellman residuals and use hindsight goal relabeling to accelerate intermediate learning. Evaluated on the Countdown task, our method alleviates optimization bottlenecks and stabilizes gradient variance significantly better than GRPO. The TBRM-RLOO framework boosts Pass@1 to 0.55--0.64 and achieves a state-of-the-art Pass@16 accuracy of 76.0--84.0\%, outperforming the SFT, IPO/DPO, and RLOO baselines. Our approach demonstrates exceptional single-sample efficiency and successfully circumvents standard performance plateaus via test-time scaling.

translated_title: 面向大语言模型算术推理的贝尔曼一致性轨迹强化学习
translated_abstract: 为了解决大语言模型算术推理中稀疏终端奖励的问题，我们提出了一种贝尔曼一致的轨迹强化学习方法。我们的框架引入了轨迹贝尔曼残差最小化（TBRM），将稀疏奖励转化为密集的词元级信号。我们集成了留一法强化（RLOO）分组策略来降低贝尔曼残差的梯度方差，并使用事后目标重标注来加速中间学习过程。在Countdown任务上的评估表明，我们的方法在缓解优化瓶颈和稳定梯度方差方面显著优于GRPO。TBRM-RLOO框架将Pass@1提升至0.55–0.64，并实现了76.0–84.0%的最先进Pass@16准确率，优于SFT、IPO/DPO和RLOO等基线方法。我们的方法展现了卓越的单样本效率，并通过测试时扩展成功规避了标准的性能平台期。
tldr: 提出贝尔曼一致的轨迹强化学习方法TBRM-RLOO，通过轨迹贝尔曼残差最小化将稀疏奖励转化为密集词元级信号并降低梯度方差，在Countdown算术推理任务上达到最先进的76.0–84.0% Pass@16准确率，显著超越GRPO、SFT、IPO/DPO和RLOO等基线。
en_tdlr: We propose TBRM-RLOO, a Bellman-consistent trajectory RL method that transforms sparse rewards into dense token-level signals via Trajectory Bellman Residual Minimization with reduced gradient variance, achieving state-of-the-art 76.0–84.0% Pass@16 accuracy on the Countdown arithmetic reasoning task and outperforming GRPO, SFT, IPO/DPO, and RLOO baselines.
